about_the_game:
A Cozy and Chaotic Garden Defense Adventure.

Welcome to Halliwell's Garden, a vibrant and ever-changing paradise where beauty and danger bloom side by side! Tend to your land by day: build charming cottages, plant bountiful crops, raise helpful animals, and nurture mystical flowers. But beware when the night falls, for your garden's allure attracts relentless hordes of monsters!

  • Cultivate Your Dream Garden: decorate your land with magic trees and cozy homes; plant vegetables, raise helpful animals and watch your sanctuary flourish.

  • Beware When Flowers Bloom: the flowers you plant aren't just pretty, they're beacons for danger! Each flower you plant will attract a different kind of monster, and maybe even a terrifying boss. The more flowers you plant, the more monsters their scent will attract! Will you risk greater rewards or play it safe?

  • Dynamic Nights, Deadly Challenges: face different threats under different moons, from the eerie calm of the Half Moon to the frenzied onslaught of the Blood Moon.

  • Strategic Upgrades, Endless Possibilities: level up and customize your arsenal with deep, choice-driven upgrades! Will you boost your damage, unleash faster attacks, or unlock powerful synergies? Every decision shapes your survival as the nights grow ever more dangerous.

With charming pixel art, lively animations, and vibrant aesthetics, Halliwell's Garden blends cozy building with intense survival action. Can you defend your home from the continuous siege of monsters that come allured by its beauty?

THE GARDEN IS YOURS TO TEND... IF YOU CAN SURVIVE ITS NIGHTS!
